title: ProdOps Roadmap Failover Scorecard & Readiness Sheet
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet combines roadmap milestones, KPI targets, and an operational failover/contingency scorecard so PMs + Ops have a single view for go/no-go decisions. Treat as a living doc: weekly cadence to update readiness scores and action items.

SCHEMA (columns):
- Milestone (text)
- Owner (name)
- Target date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- KPI metric (short)
- Baseline (value, date)
- Goal (value)
- SLO thresholds (G/A/R)
- Readiness score (0-10)
- Top mitigations (brief)
- Failover plan (brief)
- Canary config (pct / gating)
- Decide-gate triggers (auto-check)
- Runbook link (url/id)
- Notes / blockers (free text)

SAMPLE ROWS (snapshot):
1) Milestone: Hosted API GA (text-gen v1)
   Owner: Priya Natarajan
   Target date: 2026-03-31
   KPI metric: 95p latency (ms)
   Baseline: 180ms (2026-01-15)
   Goal: <=120ms
   SLO thresholds: G<=120 / A<=160 / R>160
   Readiness score: 6
   Top mitigations: enable KV prefix caching, reduce batch window for low-rt requests
   Failover plan: route to quantized-llm-v1 (higher latency but lower mem) + reduce max_tokens to 512
   Canary config: 2% traffic -> 10% -> 25% over 72h if 95p < goal
   Decide-gate triggers: if 95p>160 for >2h -> hold GA; if sustained A for 24h -> partial rollout
   Runbook link: runbook:/wiki/runbooks/hosted-api-ga
   Notes: SDK v2 missing edge-case for chunked streaming; engineering ticket OPS-4213.

2) Milestone: Dedicated Capacity Launch (reserved pools)
   Owner: Tom Huang
   Target date: 2026-04-15
   KPI metric: tokens/sec per GPU
   Baseline: 2.1k t/s (NVIDIA-A100-40GB)
   Goal: 3.0k t/s
   SLO thresholds: G>=2.8k / A>=2.4k / R<2.4k
   Readiness score: 7
   Top mitigations: tweak kernel selection policy, enable model-parallel fallback
   Failover plan: autoscale to burst pool (extra reserved capacity) + throttle background batch jobs
   Canary config: internal load with 50% production mix for 48h
   Decide-gate triggers: if sustained <2.4k for 3 consecutive 30-min windows -> delay launch
   Runbook: runbook:/wiki/runbooks/dedicated-launch
   Notes: need customer onboarding script + billing flag.

3) Milestone: Private (VPC) Beta for Regulated Customer X
   Owner: Miguel Santos
   Target date: 2026-05-05
   KPI metric: audit-log completeness (%)
   Baseline: 86% (sys generated)
   Goal: 99%
   SLO thresholds: G>=99 / A>=95 / R<95
   Readiness score: 5
   Top mitigations: add persistent log forwarder, KMS integration tests
   Failover plan: revert to staging-ha cluster with strict retention; manual export for compliance
   Canary config: single-customer pilot w/ 4 hours blocking window
   Decide-gate triggers: missing audit events >5% in any 24h window -> block beta
   Runbook: runbook:/wiki/runbooks/private-deployments-audit
   Notes: legal sign-off pending (contract template needs clause).

4) Milestone: Optimize (batching & cache) rollout
   Owner: Aisha Patel
   Target date: 2026-04-01
   KPI metric: cost per 1k tokens ($)
   Baseline: $0.95/1k tokens
   Goal: $0.60/1k tokens
   SLO thresholds: G<=0.65 / A<=0.85 / R>0.85
   Readiness score: 4
   Top mitigations: promote auto-batching defaults on medium/high throughput routes, increased TTL for prefix cache
   Failover plan: feature-flag rollback; route high-cost paths to cached responses
   Canary config: opt-in customers + internal traffic for 7d
   Decide-gate triggers: cost >A for >48h -> pause rollout; quality regression >10% -> rollback
   Runbook: runbook:/wiki/runbooks/optimize-rollback
   Notes: need evaluation set to detect quality regressions (Eval ID: eval/opt-0426).

5) Milestone: Observability KPIs (per-route tracing)
   Owner: Eleanor Kim
   Target date: 2026-03-22
   KPI metric: tracing coverage (%)
   Baseline: 64%
   Goal: 95%
   SLO thresholds: G>=95 / A>=85 / R<85
   Readiness score: 8
   Top mitigations: add automatic SDK hooks, increase retention for 30d in staging
   Failover plan: disable high-cardinality traces in peak windows to reduce load
   Canary config: all internal routes -> external route sampling at 5%
   Decide-gate triggers: sampling error rate >0.5% -> rollback sampling config
   Runbook: runbook:/wiki/runbooks/observability-tracing
   Notes: dashboard notebook saved to confluence:PRODOPS-238.

READINESS SCORING RUBRIC (how to score 0-10):
- 0-2: major blocking issues (legal, security, incomplete infra)
- 3-5: functional but risky (workarounds required, manual ops)
- 6-7: moderately ready (small mitigations needed, automation partial)
- 8-9: ready (only monitoring and docs left)
- 10: launch-ready (all acceptance tests green, runbooks exercised)

DECISION LOGIC (condensed):
- Green path: average readiness >=8 AND no R-level KPI breaches in last 7 days -> proceed with planned rollout.
- Amber path: average readiness 6-7 OR any A-level KPI sustained for 24h -> proceed with partial/canary + extended observability gating.
- Red path: any readiness <=5 OR R-level KPI breach persists -> hold; execute failover and remediation plan; require cross-functional sign-off to proceed.

AUTOMATED TRIGGERS (examples; meant for ops automation team):
- Trigger-1: If 95p latency > R threshold for >30 minutes -> create JIRA OPS-ALERT auto-ticket + page on #sre-incidents; run fallback policy: enable "quantized-llm-v1" routing.
- Trigger-2: If audit-log completeness <95% for 12h -> pause private beta traffic and notify compliance@redwood.com.
- Trigger-3: If cost/runrate rises >20% vs baseline and persists 48h -> feature-flag throttles for low-priority jobs.

QUICK ACTION MATRIX (who does what):
- Tier 1 (On-call SRE): run runbook steps A->C, escalate to Infra Lead if unresolved in 30m.
- Tier 2 (Infra/Product Engineer): implement kernel fallback, adjust autoscaler policies, coordinate canary traffic rebalancing.
- Tier 3 (PM + Product Ops): update stakeholders, hold launch if needed, coordinate customer communication.
- Exec escalation: if outage >4h or cost >100% of projected -> Exec + Legal briefing.

RUNBOOK HIGHLIGHTS (short pointers):
- host-api-ga: replication steps, smoke test commands, rollback flag names.
- dedicated-launch: autoscale knobs, expected metrics to validate after scale-up.
- optimize-rollback: stepwise revert plan for batching TTL and cache warmers.

CHECKLIST (pre-launch, all must be true OR explicitly waived):
- [ ] Security review complete (sec ticket S-2104)
- [ ] Legal SLA templates approved for customers referenced
- [ ] Performance targets validated in staging and canary
- [ ] Runbooks exercised by on-call in dry-run
- [ ] Customer-facing docs and SDKs published
- [ ] Billing and quota flags tested with dummy invoices
- [ ] Observability dashboards present for all KPIs (links in linked_artifacts)

OPEN QUESTIONS & ACTIONS (working):
- Q1: Who owns the contract clause for private beta data residency? (owner: Legal -> assigned to Nora Li)
- Q2: Finalize the quantized model fallback SLO tradeoffs (action: Research to produce latency/cost table by 2026-02-28)
- TODO: Miguel to schedule canary run for Dedicated Launch (JIRA OPS-4213)
- TODO: Priya to ship SDK v2 edge-case fix (PR referenced in linked_artifacts)

NOTES TO REVIEWERS:
- This sheet is intentionally opinionated: readiness score should reflect both technical and non-technical blockers (legal, docs, billing).
- Update the score after each weekly sync; mark stale if no updates for >7 days.
- If you change a threshold or runbook link, add a one-line change note in the Notes column.

HISTORY (changelog):
- 2025-08-14 created by Eleanor Kim (initial seed)
- 2025-09-02 added Dedicated Launch row (Tom)
- 2025-11-20 added Private Beta audit KPI (Miguel)
- 2026-01-12 Optimize rollout cost targets adjusted after perf tests
- 2026-02-20 observability KPI row added and doc promoted to in_review

END OF SHEET (working doc)
